arguments.description:
Client project tracking module. Tracks projects with the following fields:
- Project Name (Text, required)
- Client (Text, required) - name of the client organization
- Status (workflow-based) with states: Planning, In Progress, On Hold, Completed, Cancelled
- Start Date (Date)
- Deadline (Date)
- Owner (User)
- Budget (Number, currency)

Workflow:Projects start in Planning, can move to In Progress, be put On Hold, then Completed. Can be Cancelled from any active state. Users can create, edit, view, change status, comment, and delete (admin only).
